queries_run: FSLR First Solar analyst consensus vs guidance 2026
First Solar guidance raise OR cut 2026

findings.claim: 2026-10-29 Q3 財報下修全年 2026 guidance：出貨量 16.0–17.0GW（原 17.0–18.2GW）、淨銷售 $4.6–4.9B（原 $4.9–5.2B）、調整後 EBITDA $2.55–2.75B（原 $2.6–2.8B）、資本支出 $0.6–0.8B（原 $0.8–1.0B）；新聞稿未明說下修原因，並稱展望假設現行美國政策環境持續
findings.source: First Solar 8-K Ex.99.1 Q3 2026 press release (SEC)
findings.excerpt: Our outlook assumes the current U.S. policy environment persists

findings.claim: 2026 初始 guidance 營收 $4.9–5.2B 遠低於約 $6.16B 共識，多家券商降評/降目標價
findings.source: Finviz: First Solar 2026 Guidance Disappoints Wall Street Firms, Triggers Downgrades
findings.excerpt: (FSLR) 2026 Guidance Disappoints Wall Street Firms, Triggers Downgrades By Abdul Rahman | March 06, 2026, 1:50 AM FSLR +5.07% First Solar Inc First Solar, Inc. (NASDAQ:FSLR) is one of the best solar stocks to buy now. First Solar (NASDAQ:FSLR) has a consensus rating of Moderate Buy from 24 analysts.

findings.claim: Morgan Stanley 下修 2026 出貨預估至 17.6GW（原 19.7GW）、ASP 至 $0.287/W（原 $0.315）
findings.source: Yahoo Finance: Why Morgan Stanley Cut First Solar's Target as Pricing Recovery Slows
findings.excerpt: Public summaries of the note also said Morgan Stanley lowered its 2026 shipment forecast to 17.6 gigawatts from 19.7 gigawatts and reduced its 2026 average selling price estimate to $0.287 per watt from $0.315.

findings.claim: 2026-08 分析師目標價中位 $260，22 buy/12 hold/2 sell；7/31 多家下修 PT
findings.source: Walnut: First Solar FSLR Stock Forecast and Price Target
